question: Does moving Afterimage from multiplicative Mirrorlight to the non-multiplicative Refract producer make the defensive Duskblade route identifiable and viable alongside Scoreline?

shippingChangesAtThisStage: Flicker applies one Scoreline; Faultline consumes it to complete the target's remaining Facets.
Refract applies one Afterimage; Warden's Edge consumes it to reflect current Ward as damage and Ward.
Mirrorlight retains only its current-main Ward doubling; card pools, base values and Energy remain unchanged.

repertoire.discovery: frozen root-490 selection, seeds 226000-226031, Duskblade vows 0 and 5
repertoire.validation: frozen root-490 selection, seeds 227000-227063, Duskblade vows 0 and 5

estimands.functionalSeparation: Every named diagonal lower 95% bound is at least 0.25 SD and every off-diagonal upper bound is below 0.25.
estimands.heldoutViability: For each Dusk route and vow, at least two frozen policies activate the mediator and beat same-split RandomBuild by at least 0.35.
estimands.retention: Route-best rates remain within 0.10 and credited policy sets differ.
estimands.reliability: No paired candidate-added stall or simulator error.
estimands.vow5: Every frozen-policy Vow-5 win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule: All local gates admit; both routes retain at least two distinct C2 policies under both vows in discovery and validation, with controls, reliability and Vow-5 green.
inconclusiveRule: Only a non-decisive panel may extend once to 128. Frozen whole-run rectangles are final.
stopRule: Reject on a local gate, either route/vow lacking two C2 policies, collapse, controls, added fault or Vow-5 above 0.90.
